newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug crude palm oil output up 12.21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug crude palm oil output up 12.21 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 12.21 percent to 810,550 tonnes in August from 722,382 in July and against 702,085 tonnes in August 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Monday.
August palm oil exports were 638,601 tonnes against 662,035 in July and 582,750 in August last year, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output rose 7.37 percent to 638,351 tonnes in August from 594,525 in July and 564,792 tonnes in August 1995.
Output from east Malaysia states of Sabah and Sarawak rose 34.68 percent to 172,199 tonnes in August from 127,857 tonnes in July and against 137,293 tonnes in August 1995.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production rose 0.94 percent to 96,034 tonnes in August from 95,137 in July and against 88,419 tonnes in August last year.
